test_description: Grep all files in packages/core/src/planning/ for 'cinematic-video-production'; test fails if any match found, proving framework prompts contain no project-specific names
test_assertions: No file under packages/core/src/planning/ contains the string 'cinematic-video-production'
No file under packages/core/src/planning/ contains any hardcoded example project path
change_description: Replace hardcoded example path 'examples/cinematic-video-production/' in prompt templates with a generic placeholder resolved at runtime from project configuration, so framework prompts never embed specific project names
why_this_correction: Observe phase grep found 'examples/cinematic-video-production/' hardcoded in three framework files: analyze.ts:244, implement-executable.ts:111, and task-md-schema.ts:8,82 (all under packages/core/src/planning/). This directly violates the Framework vs Project rule — 'NEVER hardcode project specifics into the framework.' The grep evidence shows the framework's prompt templates bake in a specific example project name, which would cause the LLM to treat that project as special rather than reasoning generically. This single file change eliminates the root violation in analyze.ts, the primary prompt-construction file.
